ae_item_base_info_dto.subject: 50PCS Bamboo Golf Tees, Natural Wooden Golf Tees with 4 Sizes for Practice & Course Use
ae_item_base_info_dto.detail:
Product Description:


This 50PCS bamboo golf tee set includes 4 different sizes for various golf practice and course needs. Made of natural bamboo with a smooth finish, cup top, and pointed tip for easy tee-up use.


Material: Bamboo


Package: 50PCS


Sizes: 83mm/3.27in, 70mm/2.76in, 54mm/2.13in, 42mm/1.65in


Bullet Points:


50PCS Value Pack – Includes enough bamboo golf tees for daily practice, driving range, and course use.


4 Sizes Available – Comes with 83mm, 70mm, 54mm, and 42mm tee sizes to meet different playing needs.


Natural Bamboo Material – Made from bamboo with a light wood texture and smooth surface.


Easy to Tee Up – Flared cup top helps support the golf ball for convenient setup.


Pointed Tip Design – Tapered bottom makes it easy to insert into grass or turf.


Note:


Size is measured manually, so slight measurement differences are normal. Due to different monitor settings, the actual product color may vary slightly from the pictures.
